THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I , Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

Allotment of land depicted in below names and extent in the Advance Tracing No. Maha/MDD/2020/042 dated 30.06.2020, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village called Warakalandawatte in the Grama Niladhari Division of 750 Dunhinna in Palis Pattu East Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Medadumbara in Kandy District of the Central Province and bounded as follows:
01. Lot 'A' – Warakalandawatte – Extent: 0.1012Hectare North: Warakalandawatte claimed by Land Reform Commission and Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); East: Road
(Pradeshiya Sabha), Warakalandawatte claimed by A. P. Nandasena and Warakalandawatte claimed by Land Reform Commission; South and West: Warakalandawatte claimed by Land Reform Commission.
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My No.: 4 -3/5/2019/HA/552.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,"Mihikatha Medura", Rajamalwatta Avenue,Battaramulla.17th January, 2023.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I , Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Lands described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

Allotments of land depicted in below names and extents in the Advance Tracing No. MN/MNN/2023/479 dated 25.10.2023 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the village called Pavilupaddankaddikudiyiruppu in the Grama Niladhari Divison No. MN/54, of Thullukudiyiruppu in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Mannar Town of Mannar District in Northern Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot 'A' – Sinna Taylankudiyiruppu – Extent: 2.1181Hectares North: Sinna Taylankudiyiruppu (claimant not known); East: Sinna Taylankudiyiruppu (claimant not known), Road and Lot B (Road); South: Lot B (Road), Road and Sinna Taylankudiyiruppu (claimant not known); West: Sinna Taylankudiyiruppu (claimant not known).

02. Lot 'B' – Not mentioned – Extent: 0.0595 Hectare North: Lot A and Road; East: Road, UralpannaiPoolankundukkani (claimant not known) and Lot C; South: Lot C, Uralpannai Poolankundukkani (claimant not known) and Road; West: Sinna Taylankudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known) and Lot A.
03. Lot 'C' – Uralpannai Poolankundukkani – Extent:0.7124 Hectare North: Lot B (Road) and Road; East and South: Uralpannai Poolankundukkani (claimant not known); West: Road and Lot B (Road).
Harin Fernando,Minister of Tourism and Lands.
